purpose: Focused contract updates landed after amd_spirv_contracts.json schema 4.
todo: Merge these rows into amd_spirv_contracts.json before PR splitting. This addendum exists only because the connector rejected the oversized whole-file ledger replacement; it is not a second authoritative ledger.

updates.reason: Current LLVM retains the legacy intrinsic/instruction definitions but explicitly lists the corresponding ISA forms as unsupported on gfx11. Do not spend modern APUSR qualification time on them.

updates.spirv: SPV_AMD_gcn_shader CubeFaceIndexAMD/CubeFaceCoordAMD preserve the higher-level cube operation.
updates.qualification: Record v_cubeid/v_cubema/v_cubesc/v_cubetc recovery without requiring a particular low-level decomposition.

updates.amd_native: v_cvt_pknorm_i16_f32 / v_cvt_pknorm_u16_f32 / v_cvt_pk_i16_i32 / v_cvt_pk_u16_u32; packed-U8 recovery remains a higher-level candidate
updates.spirv: Direct GLSL.std.450 PackSnorm2x16/PackUnorm2x16 plus exact clamp-and-pack I16/U16 graphs.

updates.reason: Nearest-even PackHalf2x16 is not equivalent to AMD round-toward-zero packing; Vulkan FPRoundingMode use restrictions do not provide the returned packed-value contract.

updates.spirv: SPV_KHR_cooperative_matrix with explicit F16/BF16/I8/U8 component types and per-operand signedness flags.
updates.qualification: Require an exact advertised VkCooperativeMatrixPropertiesKHR match before pipeline creation, then record WMMA/SWMMAC/MFMA ISA.

updates.reason: The current SM 6.10 dx::linalg ComponentType enum has no I4/U4 matrix component. I8 matrices are not an equivalent substitute.

updates.note: BF16 cooperative matrices are now first-class through SPV_KHR_bfloat16; the remaining gap is specifically general scalar/vector HLSL BF16 arithmetic, not matrix BF16.
